run_convert_coco_panoptic_to_semantic: run the script to convert COCO panoptic annotations to semantic segmentation for train2017 and val2017
create_semantic_from_panoptic: create semantic segmentation annotations from COCO panoptic segmentation annotations using a specified categories list
process_single_panoptic_to_semantic: process a single panoptic image to semantic segmentation using an id map and segment info
review_separate_coco_semantic_from_panop: review the separate_coco_semantic_from_panoptic function that maps panoptic categories to contiguous semantic ids
summarize_process_panoptic_to_semantic: summarize the _process_panoptic_to_semantic function that converts panoptic RGB images to semantic uint8 masks
